title: Gemini API tier-gate: provenance contract for image-edit workflows
purpose: A small integration contract that makes the Gemini API tier boundary (paid vs unpaid) an explicit, machine-checkable gate in image-editing workflows. Encodes the ownership-gap (no claim, no grant) as a typed state so downstream assembly or publication steps can't silently inherit an unresolved rights posture. Compares interface against Apache-2.0 open-weight models for which an output-ownership gap does not exist in the same way.
